text.headline: Timeline of Luxembourg
text.text: Major events in the history of Luxembourg.

events.headline: Foundation of Luxembourg
events.text: Luxembourg was founded as a countship by Siegfried, who acquired the fortress of Lucilinburhuc. This event marks the beginning of Luxembourg's history as a significant political entity in Europe.

events.headline: Elevation to Duchy
events.text: Luxembourg was elevated to a duchy by the Holy Roman Emperor, making it a significant territory within the Empire. This change solidified its status and influence in the region.

events.headline: Duke John the Blind
events.text: John the Blind was granted the title of Duke of Luxembourg, further enhancing the duchy's prestige. He became a notable figure in the Hundred Years' War.

events.headline: House of Luxembourg
events.text: The House of Luxembourg gained prominence as a ruling dynasty in Europe, influencing politics in the Holy Roman Empire. This period marked the height of Luxembourg's power.

events.headline: Spanish Rule
events.text: Luxembourg came under Spanish control as part of the Habsburg territories. This marked a significant shift in governance and brought new cultural influences.

events.headline: Austrian Rule
events.text: After the War of the Spanish Succession, Luxembourg was ceded to the Austrian Habsburgs. This transition brought about changes in administration and military fortifications.

events.headline: French Revolution
events.text: Luxembourg was annexed by France during the revolutionary period. This led to significant administrative changes and the introduction of French law.

events.headline: Congress of Vienna
events.text: The Congress of Vienna established Luxembourg as a Grand Duchy under the control of the Netherlands. This event reshaped the political landscape of Europe.

events.headline: Partition of Luxembourg
events.text: The Treaty of London resulted in the partition of Luxembourg, with the western part ceded to Belgium. This division significantly impacted Luxembourg's territorial integrity.

events.headline: Luxembourg's Neutrality
events.text: The Treaty of London established Luxembourg's perpetual neutrality, which has been a cornerstone of its foreign policy. This neutrality has helped maintain peace in the region.

events.headline: Grand Duke Adolphe
events.text: Adolphe became Grand Duke of Luxembourg, marking a new era of modernization and economic development. His reign saw significant industrial growth.

events.headline: World War I
events.text: Luxembourg was invaded by Germany during World War I, leading to occupation and significant hardship for the population. The war had lasting effects on the nation's identity.

events.headline: World War II Invasion
events.text: Germany invaded Luxembourg again in 1940, leading to another occupation. The country was liberated in 1944 by Allied forces.

events.headline: Founding of Benelux
events.text: Luxembourg, along with Belgium and the Netherlands, founded the Benelux Economic Union. This cooperation laid the groundwork for future European integration.

events.headline: Treaty of Rome
events.text: Luxembourg was one of the founding members of the European Economic Community (EEC) with the signing of the Treaty of Rome. This marked a significant step towards European integration.

events.headline: Grand Duke Henri's Ascension
events.text: Henri became Grand Duke of Luxembourg, succeeding his father, Grand Duke Jean. His reign has focused on modernizing the monarchy and promoting national identity.

events.headline: Luxembourg's EU Presidency
events.text: Luxembourg held the presidency of the Council of the European Union, emphasizing its role in European politics and cooperation. This position allowed Luxembourg to influence key EU policies.

events.headline: COVID-19 Pandemic
events.text: Luxembourg, like many countries, faced the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic, implementing measures to protect public health. The response highlighted the resilience of the nation.

events.headline: Luxembourg's Climate Goals
events.text: Luxembourg announced ambitious climate goals aimed at reducing carbon emissions and promoting sustainability. This initiative reflects the country's commitment to environmental stewardship.
